subject.title: [Feature]: Allow topic/forum cron deliveries to use main-session announce/agent-turn flow instead of forced direct delivery

question: Should text-only isolated cron completions for thread/topic targets support an opt-in main-session announce/agent-turn route, and which public API plus fallback behavior should own it?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but implementing it adds or changes cron config/protocol and fallback behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add job-level route selector
options.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route enum that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit failure semantics.

options.title: Add global default plus override
options.body: Add an operator-wide cron default with per-job override, accepting the wider config surface for users who want consistent topic behavior across many jobs.

options.title: Keep direct delivery only
options.body: Preserve the current topic/thread direct-send behavior and document current/session cron or target-awareness patterns as the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Add job-level route selector
recommendation.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route enum that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit failure semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the thread/topic cron delivery boundary and recent topic-target routing work.
